school_relationship.notes: APH records the combined phrase “Fitzroy and Collingwood Secondary Schools” for Lidia Thorpe. Official Victorian sources establish that Fitzroy High School changed its name to Fitzroy Secondary College and that the 1957–1992 school closed; the current Fitzroy High School opened in 2004, so the pinned current ACARA row cannot be presumed to represent the earlier school. Collingwood College is a separate institution with its own history, and its current partnership/shared senior campus with Fitzroy High School is not evidence that the combined historical record maps to one current target. The evidence supports treating the string as potentially multiple schools but does not establish exact individual attended-school identities or any historical continuity to the pinned targets; therefore no combined mapping or split assertion proposals are made. Individual human review is required. The Sol retry added a secondary-source attendance lead describing Fitzroy High School at Year 7, Collingwood High at Year 8, and return to Fitzroy High at Year 9. The official autobiographical page corroborates leaving school at 14 only; it does not name schools. Newspaper and official-school corroboration attempts failed. Neither historical continuity nor a source-supported split mapping was established. Keep the original assertion unresolved and preserve both the earlier institutional evidence and its unreconciled 1915/1957 date conflict.

school_relationship.notes: The APH-derived case record gives only the unqualified name John Paul College. The local pinned institution register contains several distinct schools with this exact name (including Frankston VIC, Daisy Hill QLD, and Kalgoorlie WA) and a similarly named St John Paul College in Coffs Harbour NSW. Official Victorian and Queensland sources confirm distinct institutions; no person-specific source located in the allowed search budget identifies which one Jessica Collins attended. A school-wide mapping would therefore be unsafe. Leave the school policy at ambiguous_name and resolve this member assertion separately when individual evidence is available. The Sol retry researched only education:297964:0477b661fc755dd3. Two queries and four source opens, including one failed official-page fetch, supplied no campus-specific attendance evidence. The scoped assertion remains unresolved, and the ambiguous-name school policy remains necessary.
